prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve animated 2D game sprite sheet. Use the attached APPROVED new long-nosed hotel guest as the ONLY character identity and rendering master. Create ONE TRANSPARENT PNG SPRITE SHEET with EXACTLY EIGHT complete full-body frames arranged in a STRICT UNIFORM GRID of FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, chronological order left-to-right top row then left-to-right bottom row. Preferred canvas2048x1536, eight equal512x768 cells. No printed grid, frame labels, text or decoration. This is a single sprite-sheet asset, not a character model sheet.
ABSOLUTE MODEL LOCK: every frame must look exactly like reference: same bold dark-brown outer and thinner internal outlines, same compact approximately3-head proportions, olive-green skin, elongated forward nose with peach-orange bulb tip, pointed ears, swept-back angular olive hair, half-lidded eyes/arched brows, olive coat with exactly same broad simplified gold motifs and gold clasp, cream shirt, dark cropped trousers and solid dark-brown shoes. Same head size, same nose length, same costume and color palette. Clean warm flat cel-shaded game art. No paper grain, detailed brocade noise, painterly soft contours, glossy3D, or new accessories.
ANIMATION: a readable restrained in-place IDLE / SNIFF loop appropriate for standing in an open hotel doorway. Right-facing three-quarter view throughout. Legs and feet stay planted, no walking, no spinning, no turning backward, no bounce off floor. Back arm remains behind back. Subtle upper-body breathing, coherent progressive raising/lowering of the other hand, nose lift and facial expression. Eight different but closely related consecutive key poses:
Frame1 top-left: approved pose exactly, skeptical half-lidded eyes, fingers lightly at chin.
Frame2: hand leaves chin a little, fingers begin uncurling, slight eyebrow lift.
Frame3: forearm raised to chest, palm turns upward beneath nose, eyelids begin closing, nose/head lift slightly.
Frame4 top-right: palm fully open and held level at upper chest beneath nose, eyes closed, nose tilted gently upward, inhale anticipation.
Frame5 bottom-left: small peak sniff with pleased closed-eye smile and chin lifted a little more, palm still open; coat/clasp do not morph.
Frame6: head lowers toward neutral, eyelids reopen halfway, wrist begins rotating back toward face, fingers softly curl.
Frame7: hand approaches chin, skeptical expression returns, head nearly neutral.
Frame8 bottom-right: original fingers-at-chin standing pose very close to frame1 for seamless loop, tiny breathing difference only.
REGISTRATION AND SPACING ARE CRITICAL: same camera, character scale, horizontal body center and ground contact in EVERY cell. Align shoe soles to a common LOCAL baseline about92% down each equal cell. Heads and nose tips must fit within their own cell with generous clear margins. Keep character to max80% cell width and86% cell height. No limb or nose crossing cell boundaries, no overlaps between frames, no cropped hair/feet. Moderate action range of hand and expression, stable body volumes. Each frame SINGLE character, no ghost trails or duplicated limbs. Genuine alpha-zero outside silhouettes including between legs and between all frames, no background, no floor/cast shadow, no glow, no sniff symbols. Output only the complete8-frame transparent sprite sheet.
